skills.name: Shadow Strike (影出)
skills.line: My shadow is enough to beat you.
skills.description: Kainin attack a single target dealing damage equal to 80% of her ATK and ignores 40% of the target's DEF. ;Exclusive effect. :Whenever Kainin attacks, she inflicts 1 layer of Weakness, max of 3 layers. If a target has 3 layers, all layers will be consumed and she'll attack all enemies instead, dealing damage equal to 120% of her ATK. This damage does not trigger the enemy souls or passives. ;Weakness :'''General, Mark''': Kainin has learnt everything about her enemy. :''(1-3 shurikens will circle around an enemy, 1 shuriken represents 1 stack of Weakness.)''

skills.name: Shadow Withdraw (影回)
skills.description: When using normal attack, Kainin has is a 10% chance of using a normal attack on the same target again, limit of 1 extra normal attack. Limit is reset when she changes a target. ; :

upgrades.text: Chance of using normal attack again increases to 30%.
Limit increases to 2 extra normal attacks.
Limit increases to 3 extra normal attacks.
'''Exclusive effect''': At the end of an enemy's turn, has a 30% chance to inflict them with 1 layer of Weakness.

skills.name: Shadow Stealth (潜影)
skills.line: I am waiting for the opportunity.
skills.description:
Kainin creates Stealth Protection on an ally before entering into Shadow Stealth status for 1 turn.
When an ally with Stealth Protection ally is attacked for the first time, Kainin will launch a Sneak Attack on the attacker, dealing damage equal to 100% of her ATK and recovers an equal amount of HP. She also has a 100% base chance to inflict Confuse on the target, lasts for 1 turn. ;Shadow Stealth : :'''Buff, Mark''': Increases RES by 10% and SPD by 10. ;Stealth Protection : :The protection is only visible to allies and is invisible to enemies.

upgrades.text: '''Shadow Stealth''': Increases RES to 15% and SPD to 15.
After launching a Sneak Attack, her move bar is increased by 50%.
'''Shadow Stealth''': Increases RES to 30% and SPD to 30.
When in Shadow Stealth status, chance of using an extra normal attack with Shadowy Withdraw increases to 50% until the end of her next attack.

bio.condition: Team Kainin with another player's Shouzu and clear any zone 10 times.
Clear stage 9 of Orochi soul zone (solo) with Kainin.
